svg.title: PIR®, Psychedelics In Recovery™
svg.desc: The PIR® mark beside a night sky breathing toward daybreak. Constellations draw themselves in and fade: the eye in the diamond traced in stars, the Three Legacies (Recovery, Unity, Service) and the Fellowship's circle of twelve. A safe, sacred space to integrate and discuss the role of psychedelics in your recovery journey.
